resources.string:
MedBoard is a study aid for internal-medicine board-exam revision.

Content policy: every topic in this app is written in the authors' own words as an original concise revision summary. Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine (21st edition) and Davidson's Principles and Practice of Medicine (24th edition) are cited as the source texts that were studied, but no text, table or figure from those books has been copied into this app. The author(s) claim no affiliation with McGraw-Hill (Harrison's) or Elsevier (Davidson's). If you are preparing for boards, please read the source texts alongside this summary.

Clinical use: this app is a revision tool only and does not replace clinical judgement, local protocols, or an up-to-date formulary. The authors accept no liability for decisions made using it. Verify every management recommendation against the live UpToDate / NICE / local guideline before applying it to a patient.

Images: any images used are from openly-licensed sources (Wikimedia Commons, CDC PHIL, PLOS, public-domain atlases) and are attributed on the reference page.
